author: Original COD Guerra motion authored in this repository; existing M01 FK/IK solver reused
license: Original project animation; repository-wide licence remains for the owner to decide. No animation copied from games or external motion libraries.

audit.instrument: three.js GLTFLoader + AnimationMixer, foot_l/foot_r ankle proxy (tools/assets/m01-soldiers/motion/library/audit.mjs; method of the rifleman locomotion pilot audit)

clips.name: sprint
clips.semantic: armed sprint, rifle at port arms

clips.name: crouch_walk
clips.semantic: crouched advance, rifle low ready

clips.name: hit_front
clips.semantic: chest impulse from the front

clips.name: near_miss_duck
clips.semantic: defensive duck as a round passes

clips.name: turn_left_90
clips.semantic: in-place step turn left; the rotation comes from bodyYaw

clips.name: turn_right_90
clips.semantic: in-place step turn right; the rotation comes from bodyYaw

clips.name: carry_walk
clips.semantic: fireman carry, 1.6 m/s: re-authored carry_wounded (kept intact), casualty clip `carried` attaches to carry_socket

clips.name: stand_to_crouch
clips.semantic: drop to the right knee: left boot steps forward, right boot back

clips.name: crouch_to_stand
clips.semantic: rise from the right knee to standing

clips.name: prone_enter
clips.semantic: kneeling to prone: legs thrown back, chest lowered, rifle laid forward

clips.name: prone_exit
clips.semantic: prone to kneeling

clips.name: prone_idle
clips.semantic: prone, breathing, slow look along the front

clips.name: prone_flinch
clips.semantic: head ducks and chest presses into the ground

clips.name: prone_crawl
clips.semantic: leopard crawl: toes push alternately, rifle cradled in the forearms

clips.name: standing_idle_b
clips.semantic: standing weight on right leg, relaxed left foot

clips.name: standing_idle_c
clips.semantic: standing at ease, feet apart, rifle carried high, glances left and right

clips.name: crouched_idle_b
clips.semantic: kneeling on the left knee, rifle low ready

clips.name: fidget_look
clips.semantic: glance left then right

clips.name: fidget_shift
clips.semantic: shifts weight, resets the right boot, shrugs the rifle strap

clips.name: fidget_helmet
clips.semantic: right hand to the helmet brim

clips.name: fidget_check_rifle
clips.semantic: lifts the rifle to look it over, brief thumb on the safety

clips.name: hit_back
clips.semantic: impact in the back: shoulders thrown forward, knees give a little

clips.name: hit_left
clips.semantic: impact from the left: torso pushed to the right, head whips across

clips.name: hit_right
clips.semantic: impact from the right: torso pushed to the left, head whips across

clips.name: blast_duck
clips.semantic: violent crouch away from a nearby explosion, rifle clutched to the chest

clips.name: death_front
clips.semantic: hit from the front: rocks back, knees give, falls onto the back and lies still; rifle slips away

clips.name: death_back
clips.semantic: hit from behind: thrown forward, knees give, falls on the face and lies still; rifle skids ahead

clips.name: death_left
clips.semantic: hit from the left: shoved away, legs fold, falls on the right side; rifle dropped

clips.name: death_right
clips.semantic: hit from the right: shoved away, legs fold, falls on the left side; rifle dropped

clips.name: death_crumple
clips.semantic: no clear direction: knees buckle, the soldier folds and slumps onto the left side, curled

clips.name: cover_low_idle
clips.semantic: squatting below a 0.9 m sandbag line, rifle across the chest, slow look along the cover

clips.name: cover_high_idle
clips.semantic: standing against a 1.6 m wall, rifle at high port, slow look along the wall

clips.name: cover_low_peek_fire_l
clips.semantic: rises on the left edge of low cover, fires one aimed shot, drops back

clips.name: cover_low_peek_fire_r
clips.semantic: rises on the right edge of low cover, fires one aimed shot, drops back

clips.name: cover_high_lean_l
clips.semantic: leans out past the left edge of high cover, fires one aimed shot, leans back

clips.name: cover_high_lean_r
clips.semantic: leans out past the right edge of high cover, fires one aimed shot, leans back

clips.name: cover_return
clips.semantic: exposed ready stance to squatting behind low cover

clips.name: cover_leave
clips.semantic: rises from low cover to the exposed ready stance

clips.name: call_out
clips.semantic: shouts an order with the left hand cupped at the mouth

clips.name: seated_b
clips.semantic: seated, feet apart, leaning, looking around

clips.name: seated_pass_canteen
clips.semantic: passes a canteen to the soldier on the right

clips.name: seated_receive_canteen
clips.semantic: takes a canteen from the soldier on the left and drinks

clips.name: seated_cup_turn
clips.semantic: takes a cup from the left, turns, hands it to the right

integration.resolver_hooks: m01-animation-resolver already selects `sprint` and `crouch_walk` by name when present; no other name is referenced by src/
integration.overlap_policy: identical track data (tests/m01-soldiers-glb.test.js); load either package, not both under different semantics
integration.event_policy: Events are clip-local seconds for presentation only; combat events come from the simulation.
